[P2] Make mock participants consume their deadlines

`other.applyDeadline` remains the no-op installed by `participant()`, so its earliest deadline stays at `2000` after application. The new `scheduleAdvance()` therefore repeatedly applies that same deadline and queues another real immediate forever. `afterEach` only uninstalls the fake clock, leaving this loop and its growing Jest mock-call histories alive during subsequent tests. Existing fixtures with unchanged deadlines now have the same problem. Update mock completions to consume their deadlines, explicitly restore deadlines where needed, and unregister participants during teardown.
